judge.rationale: The candidate is an incomplete mid-flight attempt, as evidenced by the unchecked items in its `.lore/dod.md`. In `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts`, it compiles all schemas—including function-valued `ToolDefinitionSource` definitions—only once at `register` time rather than resolving and caching dynamic schemas per `execute` call via a `WeakMap`. It also misses the required one-line JSDoc comment on `execute`, logs `executing` before validation rather than logging a warning on validation failure, and leaves `.lore/dod.md` and `registry.acceptance.test.ts` in the tree. Most of the required unit tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts` and `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` are missing, as are all required documentation updates in `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `example/weather-tool.ts`.
